# cozystack_vpc (Data Source)

Read an existing Cozystack VPC by name and namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cozystack_vpc" "net" {
  name      = "net"
  namespace = "tenant-root"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) VirtualPrivateCloud instance name.
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace.

### Read-Only

- `chart_version` (String) Deployed chart version.
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier `namespace/name`.
- `peers` (Attributes List) VPC peering connections. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--peers))
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the application's `Ready` condition is true.
- `routes` (Attributes List) Static routes for the VPC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))
- `subnets` (Attributes List) Subnets of the VPC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))
- `uid` (String) Server-assigned object UID (`metadata.uid`).

<a id="nestedatt--peers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `peers`

Read-Only:

- `tenant_namespace` (String) Namespace of the remote tenant.
- `vpc_name` (String) Logical name of the remote VPC.


<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) Destination CIDR.
- `next_hop_ip` (String) Next hop IP address.


<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) IP address range (CIDR).
- `name` (String) Subnet name.
